<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the forward‑reaction criteria described: the forward reaction forms a C‑C bond, breaks a C‑O bond, and loses ketone and C‑C triple‑bond functional groups. Therefore, in the search I specify that the forward reaction forms a C‑C bond, breaks a C‑O bond, and forms the functional groups “ketone” and “C‑C triple bond”. This should return templates that, when applied retrosynthetically, give precursors matching the described cycloaddition.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone", "C-C triple bond"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
